performed_via_github_app.name: Gemini Code Assist
performed_via_github_app.description:
**Accelerate code reviews and improve code quality**

Bring the power of [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) directly to GitHub, providing AI-powered code reviews on your pull requests, with automatic pull request summaries, ready-to-commit code suggestions and the ability to invoke Gemini for assistance at any point on the PR.

This app is only available for Google Cloud customers. Follow the [setup instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/code-review/set-up-code-assist-github) to get started.

Corrected exact-head evidence for independent re-review

Head: `a4ac535b4612b1cca4b8073da6503e439c3034fc`

All three actionable findings are addressed generically:

1. `CIE9709_BATCH016_EXTERNAL_ROOT` now governs reconciliation reads/writes, frozen paths are rebased consistently, and emitted custody paths remain canonical. Both `import-checkers` and `prepare-resolver` replay successfully from the alternate root and report that exact root.
2. Integration copies of every resolver decision now recompute `resolved_extraction.provenance.record_sha256` before entering the verification and resolver-decision ledgers. Exactly 148 stale hashes were normalized; raw resolver output bytes remain immutable.
3. All 221 primary and 172 second-read checker files are rehashed against imported custody immediately before resolver preparation. Safe-rejection packet reads use the same authenticated helper, and a tampered file fails closed.

Verification at this exact head:

- Batch016: 20/20 tests PASS
- Batch015 regression: 22/22 tests PASS
- Batch014 regression: 14/14 tests PASS
- Total: 56/56 PASS
- Python compilation: PASS
- `git diff --check`: PASS
- alternate-root `import-checkers` + `prepare-resolver`: PASS
- tamper-fail-closed regression: PASS
- deterministic publish replay: byte-identical
- unresolved: 0
- false accepts / false overrides: 0 / 0
- provider/VLM calls during correction: 0 / 0

Corrected hashes:

- artifact manifest: `23325b93bb112e3388b5ce5c6a2044218fc3dd58fb64686b1c3027b9bfd450b9`
- deterministic reconstruction: `b7a88d75b074e5d28d1dd05049dd46e7a3c1678c7991c5d1910f5be27e82833c`
- verification ledger: `f125ceb053f75bdbf8ccb3f8b0cad287ecea88fa82b2afa872c4e88d66430594`
- resolver-decision ledger: `7ce5270e3cdb298bbda3b53cc3c539385c98cb5af1605f0f8d2d5c8a6814d47f`
- resolver custody: `70991ff647a1e930b5743c315c85a6f36dc2d507963c641300be51df7a4c26ee`

The two failing GitHub lint jobs were cancelled inside `actions/checkout@v4`; Node setup and lint steps never ran. Per #1649 this is nonblocking infrastructure state, not a deterministic code failure.

Threads remain unresolved pending independent exact-head re-review.
